## INCIDENT REPORT: Network Forensics Analysis

**Incident Date:** 2026-01-27  
**Capture Period:** Investigation of 2026-01-31-traffic-analysis-exercise.pcap  
**Analysis Date:** 2026-07-21

---

### VICTIM HOST IDENTIFICATION

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| IPv4 Address | 10.1.21.58 |
| MAC Address | 00:21:5d:c8:0e:f2 |
| Windows Hostname | WIN11OFFICE |
| Logged-in User Account | gwyatt |
| Subnet | 10.1.21.0/24 (Local enterprise LAN) |
| Role | Windows 11 workstation |

---

### MALWARE FAMILY & ATTRIBUTION

**Family:** Information Stealer / Browser Stealer  
**Attribution:** Behavioral (signature not available, but behavior is unambiguous)

The malware is a browser-based information stealer that continuously exfiltrates browser fingerprinting data and system information from the victim's web browsers (Chrome, Edge).

---

### COMMAND-AND-CONTROL INFRASTRUCTURE

| Indicator | Value |
|---|---|
| C2 Domain | whitepepper.su |
| C2 IP Address | 153.92.1.49 |
| C2 Ports | 80 (HTTP), 443 (HTTPS) |
| C2 Protocol | HTTP/HTTPS |
| C2 URI Pattern | /api/set_agent?id=\[AGENT_ID\]&token=\[TOKEN\]&agent=\[BROWSER\]&act=log |

---

### AGENT IDENTIFIERS (GROUNDED IN TRAFFIC)

- **Agent ID:** 3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C
- **Token:** 842e2802df0f0a06b4ed51f12f4387e761523b
- **Tracked Browsers:** Chrome, Edge

---

### MALICIOUS DOMAINS (OBSERVED IN DNS QUERIES)

The following malicious domains were queried by the victim, suggesting delivery infrastructure or secondary C2 endpoints:

1. **communicationfirewall-security.cc**
2. **holiday-forever.cc**
3. **whooptm.cyou**
4. **media.megafilehub4.lat**
5. **arch.filemegahab4.sbs**
6. **hiyter.com**

---

### MALICIOUS URLS

**Primary C2 Beaconing URLs (Observable):**
- http://whitepepper.su/api/set_agent?id=3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C&token=842e2802df0f0a06b4ed51f12f4387e761523b&description=&agent=Chrome
- http://whitepepper.su/api/set_agent?id=3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C&token=842e2802df0f0a06b4ed51f12f4387e761523b&description=&agent=Chrome&act=log
- http://whitepepper.su/api/set_agent?id=3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C&token=842e2802df0f0a06b4ed51f12f4387e761523b&description=&agent=Edge
- http://whitepepper.su/api/set_agent?id=3BF67EC05320C5729578BE4C0ADF174C&token=842e2802df0f0a06b4ed51f12f4387e761523b&description=&agent=Edge&act=log

---

### EXFILTRATED DATA CHARACTERISTICS

The malware exfiltrates the following data via POST requests to the C2:

- **System Information:** Windows 10/11, CPU cores (12), platform (Win32)
- **Browser Details:** User-Agent strings, Chrome/Edge versions (Chrome 144.0.0.0), plugins, WebDriver status
- **Graphics Fingerprint:** WebGL vendor (AMD Radeon R9 200), renderer details, ANGLE D3D11 pipeline
- **Canvas Fingerprint:** Base64-encoded canvas image data
- **Network Profile:** Connection type (4G), RTT (100ms), downlink bandwidth (1.55 Mbps), online status
- **Display Information:** Screen resolution (1920x1080), color depth (24-bit), orientation (landscape)
- **Font Enumeration:** Installed system fonts (Arial, Times New Roman, Courier, Georgia, etc.)
- **Audio Capabilities:** Sample rate (48000 Hz), max channels (2)
- **Cookie Settings:** Cookies enabled (true)
- **Miscellaneous:** Do-Not-Track status, PDF viewer enabled, plugins list

---

### BEACONING PATTERN

- **Frequency:** Multiple POSTs every ~7-10 seconds
- **Method:** HTTP POST to bare-domain IP (153.92.1.49) with domain name (whitepepper.su) in Host header
- **Data Volume:** Approximately 8 KB per beacon (POST data with full fingerprinting payload)
- **Total Traffic:** 10.1.21.58 ↔ 153.92.1.49: 2,345 KB (combined, ~150 KB upstream, 2.2 MB downstream over 30 seconds)

---

### TIMELINE

- **T+0 sec:** Capture begins; workstation already compromised
- **T+2.3 sec:** Network connectivity check (msftconnecttest.com)
- **T+94.6 sec:** Time sync with Google (legitimate)
- **T+95.3 sec:** First C2 GET beacon to whitepepper.su (malware active)
- **T+96.3 sec:** First C2 POST beacon with full browser fingerprinting exfiltration
- **Duration:** Continuous beaconing throughout 10-minute capture, no suspension detected

---

### INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE (IOCs)

**File Hashes:** None unique malware binaries were recovered from HTTP exports. Exported executables were legitimate Windows Update delta patches.

**IP Addresses:**
- C2: 153.92.1.49

**Domains:**
- C2: whitepepper.su
- Secondary: communicationfirewall-security.cc, holiday-forever.cc, whooptm.cyou, media.megafilehub4.lat, arch.filemegahab4.sbs, hiyter.com

**Ports:**
- 80 (HTTP to whitepepper.su)
- 443 (HTTPS to whitepepper.su)

**URIs:**
- /api/set_agent (C2 command endpoint)

**User-Agents:**
- Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/144.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
- Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Edge/(version not fully visible)

---

### DETECTION & RESPONSE SUMMARY

The victim workstation (10.1.21.58, WIN11OFFICE, user gwyatt) is infected with a browser-based information stealer malware that actively exfiltrates system and browser fingerprinting data to a command-and-control server at 153.92.1.49 (whitepepper.su) via HTTP/HTTPS on ports 80/443. The malware continuously monitors Chrome and Edge browsers and uploads detailed device fingerprinting data (hardware, GPU, audio, fonts, screen, network) every 7-10 seconds. The infection is persistent and active as of 2026-01-27.

**Recommended Actions:**
1. Isolate workstation WIN11OFFICE (10.1.21.58) from the network immediately
2. Block domain whitepepper.su and secondary malicious domains at firewall/DNS level
3. Block IP 153.92.1.49 at network perimeter
4. Conduct memory forensics and full disk imaging of victim host for malware analysis
5. Review user gwyatt's email and web browsing history for delivery vector
6. Check for lateral movement or persistence mechanisms on network
